title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your account and organization.
languageSubtitle: Choose how SequrAI speaks to you. Product names stay in English.
mcpSubtitle: Ask "Can I deploy?" from Cursor, Claude Code, or VS Code — without leaving your editor.
mcpPromoTitle: Use SequrAI in your code agent
mcpPromoBody: Ask "Can I deploy?", audit your app, and get Safe Fix prompts without leaving your editor.
mcpStep1Done: Step 1 done — your private connection key is ready
mcpBeforeConnect: We create a private key for you. Then you run one command in your project folder. Works with Cursor, Claude Code, and VS Code.
mcpStep2Body: Open the terminal in your project folder. First copy the env export, paste and run it. Then copy the install command and run it. Restart your agent (Cursor: quit fully; Claude Code: source .sequrai/mcp.env then restart).
mcpEnvCopied: Copied — paste and run in your project terminal first
mcpCommandCopied: Copied — run after exporting your key
mcpKeyOnceNote: Your key is stored in .sequrai/mcp.env by the installer — not in shell history or MCP config files.
mcpNeverCommitKey: Never commit .sequrai/mcp.env or your API key to Git.
mcpTroubleshootingSourceEnv: Before Claude Code: run source .sequrai/mcp.env so Authorization resolves from your environment.
mcpTroubleshootingRestart: Cursor: quit fully and reopen. Claude Code: source .sequrai/mcp.env, restart, then run /mcp.
mcpTroubleshootingGreen: Cursor: Settings → Tools & MCP — “sequrai” green. Claude Code: /mcp — “sequrai” connected.
mcpTroubleshootingFolder: Run the command from the folder where your code lives, not inside the SequrAI app
mcpManualToggle: I'd rather set it up manually
mcpManualStep1: Claude Code and VS Code: HTTP with Authorization from your environment (source .sequrai/mcp.env). Cursor: stdio bridge via the install command above.
mcpLocalVsRemoteHint: Local: “Analyze my current workspace”. Remote/GitHub: “Can I deploy?”
mcpSecurityNote: The installer writes .sequrai/mcp.env (gitignored). Revoke the key in Settings if it is ever exposed.
mcpRegenerateHint: Already connected? Revoke an old connection and click Connect my agent again to get a fresh command.
mcpLocalBody: Audit your current project before commit or push — no GitHub connection required (stdio bridge).
mcpRemoteOAuthHint: For Claude Desktop and ChatGPT, use OAuth discovery (recommended). Legacy API keys still work for manual HTTP setup.
mcpKeyNeverShare: Never commit this key to Git. Do not share it publicly.
oauthConsentRemoteOnly: Remote MCP analyzes GitHub repositories connected to your organization — not files on your machine.
workspaceManageDescription: Switch between Workspaces you can access.
deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account, workspace data, and cancel any active subscription.
